commands: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin main agent-control; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo CURRENT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
set -euo pipefail; export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; ./gradlew --stop || true; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon --max-workers=2

set -euo pipefail; test -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb start-server >/dev/null; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}')"; test -n "$serial"; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "1"; model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$model" = "SM-S906B"; echo DEVICE_MODEL=$model

set -euo pipefail; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}')"; adb -s "$serial" install -r -d app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb -s "$serial" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 5; echo APP_INSTALLED_AND_LAUNCHED

set -euo pipefail; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}')"; errors="$(adb -s "$serial" logcat -d -v brief -t 500 | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime: FATAL' || true)"; test -z "$errors"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo FIELD_WALK_READY
